TEXAS INSTRUMENTS.provenance: VAR-05 / D-10 — physically real 24-pin NMOS UV-EPROM, absent from minipro infoic.xml (all 28 infoic.xml '2516' hits are 25160 SPI serial parts). Wire values match the v1.15 user-override DECODE-AUDIT.md exactly (algorithm 0x0B, DIP24_2716, UV-EPROM, vpp_mv 25000, size_bytes 2048) — NOT silently moved (SAFE-04).
TEXAS INSTRUMENTS.verification_note: SAFE-04 / FUT-03: resolvable for read/info but NOT write-graduated. v1.15 bench read was unstable on real silicon (3 distinct SHAs, N=3; shared OE/VPP pin instability on the 0x0B legacy path). No write proof exists. Host guards unchanged; wire values are the v1.15 user-override values verbatim. A write graduation requires a future bench session after the OE/VPP instability is root-caused (FUT-03).

TEXAS INSTRUMENTS.provenance: VAR-05 / D-10 — TI 2532 is a physically real 4KB 24-pin UV-EPROM with a NON-JEDEC pinout (2532 != JEDEC 2732); absent from minipro infoic.xml. The 2516_EPROM.pdf is the TI 2500-series UV-EPROM family datasheet covering the 2516/2532 lineage; VPP=pin 21 / A11=pin 18 / !PD-PGM=pin 20 distinguishes the 2532 from the DIP24_2732 layout. Modeled by the new DIP24_2532 pinout entry. Carries the same UNVERIFIED posture as the 2516 row (no on-hand bench proof).
TEXAS INSTRUMENTS.verification_note: SAFE-04 / D-11: resolvable for read/info but NOT write-graduated — no on-hand 2532 silicon was bench-tested. Non-JEDEC 24-pin oddball; the DIP24_2532 pinout is a tentative leaf layout requiring bench validation. VPP lands on pin 21 (DIP24_2532 vpp-pin) per the TI family datasheet — the GATE-03 structural VPP guard is satisfied.

MITSUBISHI.provenance: Physically real 28-pin NMOS UV-EPROM (Mitsubishi M5L2764K / M5L2764K-2, 8192 x 8), absent from minipro infoic.xml. Datasheet (Mitsubishi 1985 IC Memories data book, PDF pages 351-357, vendored as datasheets/M5L2764K.pdf): interchangeable with Intel 2764, pin 1 VPP, pin 26 NC, pin 27 PGM (DIP28_2764). Read Vcc 5V; fast programming algorithm Vcc=6V, Vpp=21V, 1 ms initial PGM pulses; conventional algorithm 50 ms at Vpp=21V.
MITSUBISHI.verification_note: Resolvable for read/info. Values taken from the vendored Mitsubishi datasheet; same wire profile as the Intel-compatible 21V 2764 family. Physical write validation subject to hardware availability.
